purpose: One complete proposed three-index comparison contract, not an adopted model owner or a dynamics theorem. It replaces the failed orbit-prefix proposal, not the immutable v2 model.
authority_and_costs: NEW geometry selection: a full two-index anchored square-cell family inside the parent finite two-cell class. This is not all admissible geometries, a physical spatial dimension, or a replacement of v2's carrier class.
NEW phase cutoff schedule: successive coprime prime factors rather than the prior unapproved doubling proposal. Primitive v2 roots/rates and the integer counting definitions do not change.

NEW explicit volume comparison: all outside occupation is represented in the final retained Morton vertex. This is a comparison map, not an absorbing boundary, extra reservoir state or conditioned Gibbs law.
Full gauge and actual full anchor-cell automorphism groups are retained. The chosen anchored graphs have trivial cell group by a graph-rigidity argument; no subgroup is imposed on a symmetric graph.
All finite source observables remain, not only a passing subalgebra. Spatial support can expand to the source box; no bounded propagation radius or production locality estimate is claimed.

indices.domain: r,h,N in nonnegative integers. r is local-state cutoff, h lattice refinement, N nested combinatorial exhaustion. q0,m0 are fixed integers with 1<=q0<=m0; R0>0.
indices.order: Product partial order for algebraic comparison identities; source limit order remains r then h then N, never justified to interchange by commuting finite maps.

geometry.vertices: Pairs of integer cell addresses (x,y), 0<=x,y<W. These are construction labels, not physical embedding coordinates.
geometry.vertex_order: Morton index z=sum_b[(x_b+2*y_b)*4^b], so V indices are 0,...,W^2-1. Each dyadic 2x2 child block is one contiguous interval [4z,4z+3].
geometry.edges: One stored positive horizontal edge (x,y)->(x+1,y) when x+1<W and one positive vertical edge (x,y)->(x,y+1) when y+1<W. Enumerate by tail Morton index, then horizontal before vertical. Reverse orientations are signed, not duplicate edges.
geometry.faces: For every lower-left (x,y) with x+1,y+1<W, the closed four-edge word right,+up,-right,-up around that plaquette. All bounded faces are included.
geometry.anchors: O={(0,0)}, C={(2^h,0)}. Both are labels, never clamped field values.
geometry.degree_and_boundaries: Connected oriented finite two-cell complex with maximum degree <=4; all outer perimeter vertices/edges are the open combinatorial boundary, no periodic closure or added boundary term.
geometry.h_transport: Each old vertex v=(x,y) has representative (2x,2y) and four children (2x+b_x,2y+b_y). Each old edge is the two-edge axial path between its representatives. Each old face corresponds to the union of four fine plaquettes; signs are inherited. O,C map to fine O,C.
geometry.N_transport: Literal inclusion of the lower-left W by W subcomplex in the 2W by 2W graph; it is a Morton prefix and preserves O,C and all existing closed faces.
geometry.nominal_lattice_label: a_h=a0*2^(-h), a0>0, only the parent's refinement label. At fixed N, the named combinatorial box is refined. No physical-volume equality or metric identification is supplied or needed for this nonphysical definition contract.

regulators.phase: Let p_i be the i-th prime, p_1=2. K_r=product_(i=1,...,r+1) p_i. For an adjacent cutoff step write P=p_(r+2), K_f=P*K_c and A=P^(-1) modulo K_c.
regulators.other_cutoffs: M_s,r=2^r, M_psi,r=m0*4^r, Rmax,r=R0*2^r, Q_r=q0*2^r, independent of h,N. Thus every cutoff is unbounded, Q_r<=M_psi,r and displayed amplitude sum (Rmax/Mpsi)*Q=(R0/m0)q0 stays fixed.
regulators.frozen: epsilon,beta,nu,theta,all rate scales and other real parameters stay in the exact parent domains and remain identical across comparisons. No density/thermodynamic nondegeneracy conclusion from fixed total Q at each r.

model_and_domains.states: Exactly Omega_v2(r,h,N,Q_r) with every j,ell,n,u integer label retained; no state quotient or omitted off-image state.
model_and_domains.functional_rates: Exactly the parent F and mobility/rate formulas incorporated by the pinned v2; all primitive signed PH/TR/LK/AP incidences and duplicate K=2 labels remain.
model_and_domains.state_normalization: pi_rho=exp(-beta F_rho)/sum_(all full tuples) exp(-beta F_rho). No conditioning or replacement by a comparison pushforward.
model_and_domains.domains: A_rho=C^(Omega_rho), D(L_rho)=A_rho. A_rho^inv is the FULL source gauge/anchor invariant subalgebra. No domain of a limiting generator is declared.
model_and_domains.time: Unchanged external stochastic time; stationary initial-value law and no terminal conditioning.

state_maps.direction: p_(sigma,rho):Omega_sigma -> Omega_rho, fine to coarse, total and independent of f,t and results.
state_maps.cutoff: At the same G: j'_v=floor(j_v/2); S_i=sum_(v<=i)ell_v in Morton order; ell'_i=floor(S_i/2)-floor(S_(i-1)/2), S_-1=0; n'_v=A*n_v modulo K_c; u'_e=A*u_e modulo K_c. All operations include hidden labels.
state_maps.lattice: At the same r,N: ell'_z=sum_(b=0,...,3)ell_(4z+b); j'_z=j_(4z); n'_z=n_(4z); u'_e is the oriented sum modulo K_r of u along the two-edge representative path of e.
state_maps.volume: At the same r,h let n_c=W_c^2 and t=n_c-1. For z<t, ell'_z=ell_z; ell'_t=Q_r-sum_(z<t)ell_z. This equals the sum over the whole fine suffix z>=t. j',n' restrict to retained vertices; u' restricts to retained edges via actual cell lookup.
state_maps.general: p_(rho,rho)=id. For arbitrary comparable indices coarsen N, then h, then r by adjacent operations. Every pair of adjacent directions must commute; identities, same-direction composition and elementary squares then give path independence.
state_maps.comparison_only_warning: Volume aggregation may move occupation in the comparison output and phase projection is not small-angle rounding. Neither changes finite source dynamics. Neither implies F preservation off image, Gibbs projectivity, low defect or physical fidelity.

right_inverses.cutoff: J: double j and ell, multiply n,u by the new prime P. This is a full-tuple injection and preserves displayed s,psi,U on its image; pJ=id is required.
right_inverses.lattice: Put each coarse ell,j,n at its representative vertex; put zero ell,j,n at other children. Put each coarse u on the first edge of its disjoint two-edge representative path, zero on the second and all unused edges. No Gibbs identification is claimed.
right_inverses.volume: Copy coarse tuples on the included cells and set all new integer coordinates to zero. Total occupation stays Q. No neutral boundary is imposed on the actual full fine ensemble.
right_inverses.role: These right inverses prove surjectivity of p only. They are not new allowed generator moves or invariant fine subsets.

symmetry.gauge: Cutoff transports gauge labels g by A*g modulo K_c. Lattice restricts g to representatives. Volume restricts g to retained vertices. The u path sums telescope, so require exact p(gx)=g' p(x).
symmetry.cell: Prove the chosen anchored grids have full Aut(G;O,C)={id}. Corner distances and the marked bottom-edge C distinguish the two coordinate directions. No all-geometry equivariance conclusion.

observable_maps.direction: I_(rho,sigma):A_rho -> A_sigma, coarse to fine, If=f composed with p.
observable_maps.algebra: Require linear, unital, multiplicative and conjugation-preserving maps on the FULL finite algebras; they restrict to the full source invariant algebras by symmetry.
observable_maps.norm: Inherited ||f||_infinity over the full source finite state space; p surjective makes I an isometry. No Gibbs-L2 substitution or syntactic quotient mismatch.
observable_maps.support: For f represented at (r,h,N), and target (s,k,M), M>=N, a valid support bound is all refined vertices and internal edges of the source box G_(k,N), independent of M. Use ell'_terminal=Q-minus-retained-prefix to remove dependence on the external suffix. This bound covers every finite observable, not only a selected family.
observable_maps.stabilization: N_support(f)=N of the chosen finite representative, at fixed target k. For M>=N the same refined source-box coordinates suffice. This is SUPPORT stabilization only, not eventual generator intertwining or a bounded-radius locality theorem.
observable_maps.common_cylinder: After exact identities are admitted, D is the algebraic direct limit of all A_(r,h,N)^inv under I, with representative-independent inherited sup norm. All finite-support source observables are included. This is an algebraic core candidate, not an invariant domain for an infinite dynamics.

roots.assignment: For each valid fine incidence (x,s), y=sx, choose the lesser of directed keys (x,family,cell,sign) and (y,family,cell,-sign). In that orientation choose the first ORIGINAL valid coarse label taking p(x) to p(y), or UNPAIRED. Assign the inverse to the reverse fine incidence.
roots.retention: Keep all fine labels, all unmatched coarse labels and all multiplicities. Assignment is bookkeeping, never rate matching, label identification, averaging or division by preimage size.
roots.measure: Original pi(x) per directed root in the root Hilbert measure and sqrt(c/2) in B are unchanged.

ordered_limits.meaning: r->infinity at fixed h,N, then h, then N; later source placeholders and their unresolved analytic/physical assumptions remain exactly inherited. No selector term, time rescaling or limit interchange. Ground state only for a separately requested claim.
ordered_limits.not_in_scope: No convergence, limiting state, limiting generator, empirical identification or physical-volume proof.

future_defects.generator: Delta_(rho,sigma) f(x)=sum_(fine valid s)c_sigma,s(x)[f(p(sx))-f(px)] - sum_(coarse valid r)c_rho,r(px)[f(r px)-f(px)]. Retain all unpaired channels.
future_defects.primary: max_x |Delta f(x)| on the full fine state space.
future_defects.separate: Gibbs-L2 Delta and p_*pi_sigma-pi_rho are separate diagnostics, not assumed small.
future_defects.eventual: For a future exact claim, supply a fixed f and a generator-stabilization index and prove Delta=0 at all subsequent pairs in the declared ordered stage. SUPPORT stabilization is not that proof.
falsifiers: Noncommuting r/h/N square or failed composition
Incorrect full gauge/cell symmetry or omitted invariant observable
Spatial support still depends on arbitrarily far target-volume coordinates
Missing/merged signed incidence or altered rate/state/time
Nonzero finite Delta refutes that exact pair only; eventual or limit failure requires the appropriate quantified witness

preapproval_checks.exhaustive_coarse_right_inverse: Original model's full state formula on the smallest new graph at (0,0,0) only; no full fine-state enumeration claim.
